seo_title: Free Consulting for Bloomington Nonprofits | Net Impact IU
seo_description: Net Impact IU student teams give Bloomington-area nonprofits free, semester-long consulting in market research, growth, operations, sustainability and data.
headline: Free consulting for Bloomington nonprofits
intro: Net Impact IU offers free, semester-long consulting to Bloomington-area nonprofits. A team of six IU students works on a project you define, meets with you regularly, and delivers finished work by the end of the semester.

services.name: Market Research
services.text: Research on your audience and community needs.

services.name: Growth and Scalability
services.text: Plans to reach more people and expand your programs.

services.name: Operations Analysis
services.text: Assessing how your operations run and where they can improve.

services.name: Sustainability Strategy
services.text: Practical steps to reduce environmental impact and plan for the long term.

services.name: Financial Sustainability
services.text: Funding and revenue ideas to keep your mission resourced.

services.name: Data and Analytics
services.text: Turning your data into clearer decisions.

steps.title: Reach out
steps.text: Email us with a short description of your organization and the help you need.

steps.title: Scope the project
steps.text: For fall projects, discovery calls in July and August define the work.

steps.title: Kick off
steps.text: Your student team starts in October and meets with you weekly or biweekly.

steps.title: Get results
steps.text: The team presents finished work in December, and you share mid-semester and final feedback.

cta_text: Fall projects are scoped in July and August and kick off in October.
time_text: About 10 hours of your time over the semester gets 150+ hours of ours: 15x your time, at zero cost.

client_quote.quote: The team did far more than we expected. They turned our scattered ideas into a clear outreach and fundraising strategy, backed it with real community research, and left us with materials we still use every week. It felt like working with a professional firm.
